def _predict_chamber(taus, theta, x, hold, times, strain_0):
    """Reset the chamber memory and couple coupon drift to the two branches."""
    drift = theta[2] + x @ theta[3:]
    fractions = np.asarray(_DRIFT_FRACTIONS)
